source: TSMC 3Q26 earnings release and management report, 15 Oct 2026
title: Which chips the money comes from
notes: Process nodes in nanometres (nm): smaller is newer and harder to make.
basis: Share of TSMC wafer revenue by process technology

beats.caption: A third of wafer revenue now comes from 3nm. The newest, 2nm, is already 8%.
Almost four in five wafer dollars come from processes few rivals can match.
